findings: Repository numeric ID plus repair SHA identifies a Git object but not the complete repair range.
A PR base, an explicit commit parent, or another branch can supply different valid pre-repair snapshots for the same repair SHA.
One commit fixing multiple issues and multi-fix commits are not identity ambiguities when the candidate unit remains one code-repair episode and all source-task provenance is retained.
Backports, cherry-picks, and equivalent patches at different SHAs must remain distinct episodes; they may be marked possible duplicates but must not be auto-collapsed.
checks.required_amendment: Include candidate_snapshot_commit_sha in the canonical candidate identity envelope and define task-provenance preservation.

findings: v0.2 fails closed above 1,000 results but defers date sharding to a later unspecified amendment.
The frozen created-at range is a non-semantic partition field and supports deterministic UTC-second ranges.
checks.required_amendment: Freeze recursive created-at partitioning, count reconciliation, and atomic-overflow behavior before execution.

findings: Endpoint, API version, query, page/cursor, sort/order, timestamp, status, selected headers, and response hashes are required by v0.2.
Deterministic connection/read deadlines, retryable failures, retry delays, redirect limits, and rate-limit exhaustion behavior are absent.
checks.required_amendment: Freeze attempt-level request metadata and bounded timeout/retry/redirect rules.

findings: v0.2 requires exact bytes and SHA-256 before normalization.
It does not fully specify content-addressed placement, no-overwrite behavior, failed-attempt retention, or a manifest schema binding every artifact.
checks.required_amendment: Add a content-addressed raw-artifact layout and immutable capture-manifest schema.

findings: Explicit benchmark and advisory commit anchors are deterministic subject to resolution and ancestry rules.
GitHub documents that merge_commit_sha denotes a merge commit, squashed commit, or updated base commit depending on merge method.
v0.2 uses base.sha for every merged PR without resolving multi-commit single-parent squash/rebase ambiguity.
checks.required_amendment: Derive PR snapshots from immutable endpoint topology and fail closed for multi-commit single-parent topology without explicit immutable method evidence.

findings: Explicit advisory commits use their sole parent and reject merge-parent ambiguity.
BugsInPy supplies an explicit buggy snapshot but v0.2 does not require a captured ancestry proof to the fixed commit.
PR base.sha is not sufficient as the sole topology proof for all merge methods.
checks.required_amendment: Freeze per-anchor snapshot derivation and benchmark ancestry proof requirements.

findings: v0.2 correctly prohibits missing-value wildcard matches and makes source priority provenance-only.
It requires all duplicate source provenance to be attached but does not define a deterministic candidate-to-source-record provenance index.
checks.required_amendment: Require an append-only, sorted candidate provenance index while retaining every source record.

findings: Malformed BugsInPy metadata, malformed or withdrawn advisories, incomplete search results, and missing PR detail already fail closed.
Deleted or transferred repositories, inaccessible commits, transient API failures, redirects, rate-limit exhaustion, and source schema drift require exact transaction-level dispositions.
checks.required_amendment: Add deterministic failure taxonomy and transaction rollback/no-partial-materialization rules.

findings: v0.2 defers trust family, p*, triplet, scoring, selection, and experimental status.
Query trust-family basis is provenance for prospective query design and is not a candidate assignment.
Model feasibility and security-relevance ranking should be named explicitly as forbidden discovery outputs.
checks.required_amendment: Enumerate every forbidden scientific assignment and prohibit ML or heuristic ranking.

findings: The blocking ambiguities occur before any additional-source execution and can be corrected prospectively without identity-dependent choices.
checks.required_amendment: Freeze and validate additive protocol v0.3 before source execution.

documentation_consulted.claim: GitHub REST search exposes at most 1,000 results per search.
GitHub search accepts UTC timestamp ranges for created qualifiers.
A merged PR's merge_commit_sha meaning varies across merge, squash, and rebase methods.
Rate-limit responses use Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers and require bounded retry behavior.
